traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports growth, fortune, and patronage - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. Two benefics: among the easiest contacts, though it can incline to excess.
modern: Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease. The trine makes this a natural strength: Warmth, goodwill, and good fortune in what you value. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Connection and growth flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what connection and growth have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: Money, goodwill, and public support can arrive around something people are genuinely glad to back.
readerCopy.body: Money, goodwill, and public support can arrive around something people are genuinely glad to back. Venus trine Jupiter can make generosity easier to receive and easier to extend, especially when a fundraiser clears its goal, a celebration includes the people who built it, or a partnership grows without reducing anyone's share to make room. Let the good response be good. Then protect what made it worth supporting. Pay the contributors, keep the terms fair, and use the extra resources to widen the benefit rather than decorate the success.
